Phi 4 Mini Reasoning — —
ESTIMATED for the 3 models marked above, from what hosts serving
them actually received over the last 30 days:
$0.42 compliance floor for being able to serve, asked for or not
$0.27 demand share real user traffic, split one more way
$2.50 routed work LLooMA traffic, scaled by model count
$3.19 per month
An estimate, not a promise of payment. This is not a projection of
profit, or of any income at all. Many hosts receive nothing, payments
are discretionary and may be zero, and these amounts are before your
electricity and hardware costs — which will often exceed them.
About 2 of these stay loaded in 30 GB of GPU memory;
the other 1 load when a request arrives. That costs a few seconds,
and a host that already has the model warm often wins the request — so more
memory earns more of the demand half, not more models.
Over the same 30 days the 16 hosts on the network took home
between $0.00 and $25.66 each: a quarter under $2.04, the middle host $10.50,
the top quarter over $20.07. Most of that spread is uptime, not hardware.
